scope: Alfredo P0; request-level visible output tokens; validation only

provenance.split_hash_algorithm: SHA256 C-order little-endian int64 [source_row_id,turn_index,group_id,timestamp_us] in retained row order

reference_checks.reason_for_refit: PR24 saved aggregate pinball only, no predictions/MAE; fixed selections refit for missing losses and paired CI

lag1_definition: B plus only previous eligible output tokens, same source conversation; skip invalid pairs; no ratio/EWMA/count extra; NaN without history

h1_definition.slope: last two valid outputs difference / original user-turn gap
h1_definition.previous: previous eligible pair in the same source conversation, not group or user
h1_definition.missing: NaN except count=0; std=0 for one prior observation
h1_definition.zero_input: ratios undefined; ratio EWMA skips zero-denominator observations
h1_definition.update_order: snapshot before adding current response; current input is available

training.selection: lag1 only: train-internal row mean pinball, 3 candidates; other four reuse PR24 selections

bootstrap.method: percentile 2.5/97.5 linear; fixed model; no refit/reselection
